notes: Criterion text: one live run produces a results JSON. A parsed result with components is exactly that.
Criterion text: every non-pass in the results JSON is classified. Classification is a person's judgement, so the tool needs --classified; it never invents one.
Criterion: churnmud works in a non-Greentide biome when opted in. The component spawns a fresh non-Greentide map with crossBiomeEnabled and reads churnmud seeded once.
Names save aliases, steam devil and toxin-sealed floor on a quicktest map; no Greentide component reads those three (defs_resolve reads defs, not behaviour).
